capacities, featuring an addition of over 55 gigawatt during 2025-26.
With its preset target of achieving 500 gigawatt of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030,
the central government highlighted solar and wind energy as the major contributors
competitors in its vision of clean energy dependency or report.
The government has shared some figures with respect to the requirement for energy storage
to store renewable energy.
It noted that the Central Electricity Authority projects around 74 gigawatt of storage capacity
This includes around 27 gigawatt from pumped storage projects and over 47 gigawatt from

In addition, the government has also taken a series of co-ordinated policy, regulatory,
demand side and supply side measures to promote the development and deployment of pumped storage
projects.
Some of the measures include policy clarity, fiscal support, streamlined clearances, competitive
procurement and integrated grid planning.

India will host the 61st meeting of the International Committee of Legal Metrology for the first
time from the 26th of this month in New Delhi.
The three-day meeting marks a significant milestone in India's growing role in
international cooperation, harmonisation of measurement standards, promotion of fair trade
and consumer protection.
French President Emmanuel Macron has expressed concern over security failures that led to
violent protests across the country, but rejected the resignation of Interior Minister
Laurent Nunes amid the crisis.
According to local media reports, at least 2,400 people have been arrested following
the unrest, during which town halls were set on fire, and hundreds of businesses were looted
or damaged.
Macron directed the Interior Minister to ensure transparency over the planning and intelligence
failures that led to the violence, and introduced new operational methods for security forces.
The protests followed calls by labour unions, student organisations and activists.
Russia attacked Kiev with ballistic missiles and drones overnight, killing one person
and injuring eight others as well as damaging buildings and infrastructure in three districts.
Ukraine's Air Force today said Russia launched a large-scale overnight air attack with ballistic
missiles, cruise missiles and 269 drones. Ukrainian air defenses destroyed or suppressed
243 drones and four missiles. Strikes were recorded at 25 locations and April from downed
targets fell in eight locations. The list of targets hit in QF include a data center,
a fire point, logistics hub, where components for drones and Flamingo cruise missiles are
stored, an industrial facility making drone components, and a locomotive depot where missiles
are stored.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has congratulated Indian Shooter Mona Agarwal on winning gold

The Prime Minister said her remarkable achievement has made India's opening day even more

Ekta Vishnoi has won three gold medals at the World Masters Classic and Equipped Power
Lifting Championships in Nevada, USA.
She claimed the top honours in the 57kg category with a combined lift of 362.5kg.
She lifted 130kg in squat, 72.5kg in bench press and 160kg in deadlift,
finishing ahead of competitors from Canada and Japan.
